audience: church staff and volunteer coordinators who manage their congregation in Breeze ChMS

useCases.title: Find people by tag, status or profile field
useCases.text: The AI lists people filtered by tag, status, gender or other profile fields and opens a profile with address and family members. You get a list for a group or mailing.

useCases.title: Review who checked in to an event
useCases.text: The AI finds event instances in a date range and reads who checked in, with check-in time, or only the head count.

useCases.title: See who is scheduled to volunteer for an event
useCases.text: The AI reads the volunteers scheduled for one event instance with their response, comment and roles, so you can see who still has to answer.

useCases.title: Review gifts given in a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists recorded contributions in a date range, narrowed by giver, amount, payment method, fund or batch, and sums them per fund. It does not change gifts.

useCases.title: Add or update a person and tag them
useCases.text: The AI checks for duplicates, adds a person or changes profile fields such as email, phone and address, and assigns a tag such as a small group.

useCases.title: Add an event, record attendance or schedule a volunteer
useCases.text: The AI adds an event to a church calendar, checks a person in or out at an event instance, or schedules a person as a volunteer for it.
